features.note: machined/cast ribbed block with suction/discharge flanges, rotor-profile discharge end and brass oil sight glass; clearly differentiated from the motor, not a smooth cylinder
grey sheet-metal cabinet with louver banks + hinged access door with real panel gaps; enclosed compressor, matches Atlas GA grey box
airend -> orange separator -> aftercooler -> outlet valve joined by copper piping in correct order; ports connect
radiator block with large axial fan behind wire guard grille at -X; clearly present and spin-ready
front HMI with readable emissive teal display + red mushroom e-stop on the canopy face

important_features.note: finned TEFC motor with terminal box, coupled to airend through guarded coupling
copper oil/air lines routed root->tip between airend, separator and cooler; no floating stubs
brand-neutral AIRTECH data plate reads as printed spec text, no real-brand logo

defects: Hero lacks a large stamped brand graphic seen on the GA reference (minor, non-blocking)
Airend rotor discharge cap yellow reads slightly toy-like at close range
Louver banks on the hero exterior are subtle relative to the reference panel doors
corrections: Optional polish: add a subtle large canopy graphic/decal to strengthen GA product read on the hero
